name: engine-wasm-test-studio-record-loop-example
description: Worked example + guard: a Test-Studio-style record loop driven entirely by the built @nanobpm/engine-wasm TestEngine. Shows that an embedded single-session engine gives Camunda's Test Studio isolation (RESERVE_JOBS + stubCallActivities) for free — jobs wait unraced, and the debug stepper is the call-activity wait state.
